title: How Many ROOOOKS To BEAT GothamChess?
summary: Revisit of the Gotham bot challenge with rooks instead of pawns (meme). Game 1 is played even vs the GothamChess bot (~2500); it lasts 125 moves, includes a rook sacrifice and ends in a draw, which Tony counts as the win, so no extra rooks were ever added.
rules: Plan: game 1 even, then replace pawns with rooks one at a time after each loss (same format as the Stockfish rook video).
win_condition: Beat Gotham; in the video a 125-move draw in game 1 was accepted as the result.

opponent.name: GothamChess bot (Levy Rozman)
opponent.avatar_description: cartoon Levy Rozman: short dark hair, round glasses, goatee/beard, blue-teal hoodie

setup: Game 1 standard FEN; subsequent games pawns→rooks (never reached).
events: +1 rook replacing a pawn per loss (planned)
visual_fx: Thumbnail: board full of white rooks, '16 Rooks? No...'
current_impl_issues: Impl kingplus t=R gives king + rooks only; video uses full army, starting even, rooks replace pawns.
evidence: 0:02 'many of you commented I should have played with the Rooks... first game even'; 24:17 'that game took 125 moves... a draw for me against a 2500 bot that's a win in my book'.
